source.author: cic
source.text: Quid si, inquit Crassus quoniam ego, quo facilius vos apud me tenerem, vestrae potius obsecutus sum voluntati, quam aut consuetudini aut naturae meae, petimus ab Antonio, ut ea, quae continet neque adhuc protulit, ex quibus unum libellum sibi excidisse iam dudum questus est, explicet nobis et illa dicendi mysteria enuntiet?
source.text_original: 'Quid si,' inquit Crassus 'quoniam ego, quo facilius vos apud me tenerem, vestrae potius obsecutus sum voluntati, quam aut consuetudini aut naturae meae, petimus ab Antonio, ut ea, quae continet neque adhuc protulit, ex quibus unum libellum sibi excidisse iam dudum questus est, explicet nobis et illa dicendi mysteria enuntiet?'
source.text_english: What if, said Crassus, since I, in order the more easily to keep you here with me, have yielded rather to your wish than either to my habit or my nature, we ask Antonius to set forth for us those things which he is keeping back and has not yet brought out, one of which he has long been complaining has slipped from his little book, and to declare those mysteries of oratory?

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: hoc enim et Tullius tuus et ante illum in breui et solo uolumine scribit Antonius, primam causae esse uictoriam diligenter causam, pro qua dicturus es, discere.
reuse.text_original: hoc enim et Tullius tuus et ante illum in breui et solo uolumine scribit Antonius, primam causae esse uictoriam diligenter causam, pro qua dicturus es, discere.
reuse.text_english: For this your Tully too, and before him Antonius in a brief and single volume, write that the first victory of a case is to learn carefully the case for which you are going to speak.
